messages.subject: Jake Essex – Professional Solo Vocalist (Elvis & Friends Show) Available for Live Music Nights
messages.body:
Hi Team at Greenhithe Legion Social Club,

I’m Natalie, booking agent for Jake Essex.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist based locally in South Ockendon who delivers a high-energy “Elvis and Friends” show — proper 50s, 60s & 70s classics that get the whole room singing along.

I noticed you put on live music and I genuinely think Jake would be a perfect fit for your crowd. He’s fully self-contained (PA, lights, backing tracks), reliable, no deposit required, and used to busy pub, club and function room crowds.

You can check out recent performances and crowd reactions here: https://www.instagram.com/jakeessexmusic/

He’s available for midweek or weekend nights and his normal rate for pubs/restaurants is very competitive — happy to discuss dates, set times and pricing that work for you.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Natalie
Booking Agent for Jake Essex
jakeessexenquiries@gmail.com
@JakeEssexMusic

messages.body:
Hi,

I'm Natalie — I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Greenhithe Legion already has Kevin Powell as GM on the enquiries inbox,
and the club is the live room on London Road.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist from Essex. High-energy 50s and 60s
rock and roll. He is the act — no tribute, no jumpsuit. Own PA, fully
self-contained, no deposit.

2 × 1 hour is £250 cash on the night, or £280 if it goes through the books.

Have a look: www.jakeessex.co.uk

Friday nights, Saturdays, Sundays and functions this year and into 2027 —
if a date works, reply here and I'll lock it.

Natalie
